pages.text: COMMUNITY MAKERS MORNING Event Overview Community Makers Morning A fictional half-day gathering for people who enjoy simple craft projects. The event combines short demonstrations, shared work tables and a small display of finished projects. All activities use ordinary reusable materials. Purpose Offer a relaxed place to try a new activity and exchange practical ideas. Participants may spend the morning on one project or move between tables. Format The practice event takes place in a single community room. There are three activity areas: paper craft, simple model building and drawing. A quiet table is available for planning and individual work. Synthetic practice document. No real event or personal information. 1

COMMUNITY MAKERS MORNING Venue and Materials Room layout Place the shared work tables in the centre of the room with wide walkways. Keep the demonstration table near the front and the display along one wall. A separate shelf holds reusable supplies and finished examples. Materials Paper sheets and card offcuts Pencils, washable markers and rulers Reusable building pieces and small trays Table coverings and labelled storage boxes Room preparation Arrange supplies by activity before the room opens. Keep walkways clear and leave space for seated participation at every table. At the end of the morning, return reusable materials to their labelled boxes. Synthetic practice document. No real event or personal information. 2

People may work at their own pace during the open sessions. Leave the final quarter-hour free for arranging the display and tidying. Synthetic practice document. No real event or personal information. 1
